item.content:encoded:

Open Firmware FCode ROM for Juniper Radeons (HD 5750/5770/6750/6770) in a PCIe Power Mac G5 - lyons88/rdn-fcode
github.com

I don't have the real card yet, so this has only been tested in emulation.

The PC VBIOS is fully copied as the first image in ROM so even if the FCODE fails in a real PowerMac the card 'should' still work in a PC just like it always has.

The FCode has a full AtomBIOS interpreter written in Forth (src/atom.fs, a port of Linux’s atom.c). At boot it:
